defects_argued.quote: Thus, the impugned orders, having been passed without a proper SCN, are in violation of Section 73 and Rule 142(1)(a).
Therefore, unless these documents are duly authenticated by the Proper Officer, they fail to meet the statutory requirements and are rendered invalid and unenforceable.
Accordingly, the Court held that non-compliance with Section 75(4) in the present case violates both statutory requirements and principles of natural justice, thereby vitiating the impugned order.

outcome.quote: Writ petition accordingly stands allowed in the manner indicated above.
